sources.title: String theoretic QCD axion with stabilized saxion and the pattern of supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Represent the uplifting brane by a sequestered Volkov–Akulov operator. In Einstein frame it adds Vlift = e4A P0 exp(2K/3) to VF without changing the conventional on-shell moduli F-component expression.

destinations.title: Can a PQ-invariant generalization of KKLT stabilize the saxion while leaving the QCD axion unfixed until QCD effects arise, and what moduli spectrum, supersymmetry-breaking mediation, and flavor/CP properties follow?

destination.title: Corrections and the background for stabilization
destination.question: How do stringy or quantum corrections change moduli potentials, vacuum-energy hierarchies and the validity of the background used for stabilization?
destination.summary: Provides alternate homes for correction-driven nonsupersymmetric extrema and the distinct static-versus-rolling flux-background test.

systems: Flux backgrounds with supersymmetry breaking below the KK scale
targets: Corrected AdS, Minkowski or metastable de Sitter extrema
One-loop vacuum energy relative to supersymmetry breaking
Treatment of nonperturbative effects on rolling backgrounds
assumptions: The correction expansion and background must each be justified.
The small loop-corrected cosmological constant is a proposed mechanism, not a demonstrated general solution.
includes: Distinct correction sectors without identifying their mechanisms
excludes: An established universal obstruction to static flux backgrounds

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking by Fluxes

evidence.text: Do flux configurations that break supersymmetry below the KK scale supply static backgrounds around which quantum stabilization can be computed, or do higher-derivative corrections instead require rolling solutions and a different treatment of nonperturbative effects?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking by Fluxes

evidence.text: Corrections to K are used with the supersymmetric scalar-potential formula and perturbative nonrenormalization of W to diagnose a physical potential. An explicit sextic-fourfold example uses adjunction and obtains ∫M J∧c3=−420, illustrating a nonzero perturbative correction.

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking by Fluxes

evidence.text: Power counting combines flux quantization, the M2-charge tadpole and the higher-derivative expansion. The analysis compares flux stress-energy, R⁴ interactions and their supersymmetric flux completions, including contributions at matching orders from different derivative orders.

sources.title: Stringy corrections to Kahler potentials, SUSY breaking, and the cosmological constant problem

evidence.text: Can string corrections to the Kähler potential alter KKLT-type moduli stabilization, produce supersymmetry-breaking AdS/Minkowski/metastable de Sitter minima, and permit a one-loop corrected cosmological constant much smaller than the supersymmetry-breaking scale?
